reason: Reviewed shared tool-free Agent-owned completion path for ordinary isolated Runs. Execution config keeps provider policy only; public adapter schemas/request validation, events, usage and completion policy retained. Exact greeting-only exchanges defer naming until substantive history; bounded jobs do not block source answers. Former private duplicated completion field declaration removed in favor of AgentDefinition. Hub observation cost review: ObservationReads owns bounded transient service-result caching and two-second reconciliation, never domain persistence or authorization. SnapshotReader invalidates on canonical Engine/Run events and explicit Hub mutations, retains only one conversation and rejects late cache fills after invalidation. Worker polling is paced after completion; input preemption and storage cancellation semantics remain. Selection uses the existing dirty publisher and starts only unopened Sessions. Backend methods, persisted formats, approvals, retries and Run/Step ownership are unchanged. tests.hub.test_observation_reads and existing snapshot/progress/submission/live integration tests verify actual read counts, event loss, lifecycle freshness, invalidation races and focus. Low-resource Hub observation review: public service observations retain backend ownership, durable writes, authorization and resume admission. ConversationProjection owns disposable selected-history rows with event/reconciliation invalidation and retained source identities. Settled rows are pruned; live/paused/latest output remains observed, not inferred. SessionNamer deduplicates source/config checks without caching execution settings. Settings usage is an explicit read command; catalog no longer aggregates receipts. Nonblocking usage completion is catalog-scoped and updates text/chart without writing settings. Hidden refresh coalesces ordinary deltas but lifecycle/interactions and reopening remain urgent. Selected/nonselected expiry changes only observation freshness. No llm implementation, persisted record format, storage reader or execution/retry authority changes.

No policy thresholds or approval bypass are introduced. See tests/llm/reports/contract-hardening-20261105; earlier occurrence findings remain preserved in audit-unclassified-20261105.

Read complete manifest/record projections and validation, paired name/revision witnesses, permanent deletion evidence, operation event Writer and common step observation. Fixed fields come from dataclass slots or Owner Field declarations; record keys and revisions are dynamic validated identities. Only absent fresh checkpoint/initialization can supply empty records. Exact current schema/owner/revision and saved interactions remain mandatory. Retirement uses Run active-state declaration and its declared terminal exceptions; abandonment evidence stays required for failed/interrupted/paused Runs. Common step reads do not interpret private payloads or grant resume permission. Nested scope projection review: existing CheckpointEnvelope lifecycle validation and new construction reuse the same retry-required predicate; Reader rejects contradictory explicit evidence as before. CheckpointContent emits a validated runtime content projection in the existing header/records order. CheckpointStep owns required interaction attachment and separate nullable waiting observation, retaining original values without normalizing opaque input. No storage schema, lifecycle, authority or ACK boundary changes. Agent usage Reader obtains mandatory lifecycle status through CheckpointStep.required_status, retaining the original KeyError and no missing-record fallback; no other record/interaction behavior changed. Agent execution closure: required-Tool completion shares one AgentPolicy validator. Pause reference owns only its event field, preserving storage existence validation and Engine-specific private pause keys. Selected resources retain pair unpacking with named access. Optional Engine hooks and graph parent-name fallback retain the existing protocol and missing/null distinction; no stored evidence is manufactured. Connected original Run consumers to canonical admitted snapshot Writers, scalar checkpoint projection, explicit operation/plan values and public optional Engine/Capability hooks. No default, migration, runtime authority or persistence format change; existing incomplete Hub contracts remain tracked.

reason: Read complete model file and consumer connections: current-format field/version validation, timezone requirements, pure transition validation, extensible configuration and its closed sections, every Project/Session/Message/Run/Step declaration and Reader. Run edges now use a read-only map of frozensets; Step edges a frozenset; exact allowed transitions/reasons/diagnostics remain. ConversationStorage schema uses canonical Schema declarations and input policy; llm bootstrap and ProjectConversations explicit choice paths share it. Project/Session JSON copies/target validation, components initialization, Agent binding and active Run identity/evidence remain. Dynamic configuration/record fields derive from their schema/type declarations. Step observations delegate the existing typed envelope Owner; clocks/UUIDs are generated only by creation, never missing-record repair. Context-specific mode categories now have one predicate declaration; Message unbound Run and detached-copy mutation are explicit. All prior methods and current stored fields/defaults remain unchanged; prior shared contract decisions are retained. Message.validate_changes delegates complete proposed-record validation to its existing Reader without new fields, defaults or mutable state. Existing consumers and their prior decisions are preserved. History consumers share existing Session retention marker and Message pending states without coercion, default or category change; prior Owner contracts and classifications remain intact. Connected original Run consumers to canonical admitted snapshot Writers, scalar checkpoint projection, explicit operation/plan values and public optional Engine/Capability hooks. No default, migration, runtime authority or persistence format change; existing incomplete Hub contracts remain tracked. Narrow lifecycle consumers now use existing domain state/error/path declarations, optional Component hooks and explicit model-observation contract. Pure guards/projections preserve required lookup and live-client semantics; no stored format or execution permission change. Narrow public Facade consumers use the Run-owned resumable candidate states, EngineEvent factory, live RunManager gauges and uncommitted operation preview. All required safety checks and original read/effect order remain. Domain-time review 2026-11-05: common RecordTimes moves to core. Domain readers require both UTC times; existing repositories reuse their validated prior record and same atomic write. Actual owned-record changes touch updated_at; children/output streams do not touch parent records. Agent envelope dates are excluded from definition/CAS/approval binding. Creation-time immutability, no-op, rollback and existing execution-state evidence remain explicit. Import-only consumers preserve their algorithms.

reason: Each domain Paths class declares its existing filename/directory components before methods. Accessors compose these same values without new paths or normalization. Narrow optional Component schema hook, read-only presentation annotations and Backend workspace path declarations preserve existing policy/record/locking semantics. Narrow lifecycle consumers now use existing domain state/error/path declarations, optional Component hooks and explicit model-observation contract. Pure guards/projections preserve required lookup and live-client semantics; no stored format or execution permission change.

External incomplete consumers remain incomplete. Completion-policy dependency review: resource keyword/kind and registry lookup declaration only. Registered callback identity, absent-attribute empty observation and explicit None remain unchanged; no default registry is constructed by observation. Schema algorithms and prior classifications are unchanged. Incomplete external consumers remain incomplete. Agent declaration review adds existing minProperties/pattern vocabulary only. The complete prior Schema algorithms and classifications remain; external consumer closure is still incomplete. Engine factory/schema review: selected validation delegates unchanged AgentDefinition rules with the same diagnostic identifier; canonical SchemaExtension and EngineConfigurationKey share key selection/writing across Graph/Loop/Registry/settings. Original key scalar acceptance is preserved separately from typed response validation. ConfigurationView.resolver owns optional public resolution discovery; absence/default/explicit inputs are unchanged. Existing complete and incomplete contracts remain tracked. Added only SchemaExtension.RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION and migrated two existing consumers; all previous module AST and classifications are unchanged. The existing incomplete core/schema contracts remain incomplete. Vision image delta: maxItems is declared once at SchemaKeyword. All thirteen prior Schema functions remain unchanged; previous complete/incomplete consumer tracking is preserved. Provider request delta declares the existing open-parameters Schema keyword, delegated observation code and call identity Writer; all existing shared function bodies and prior contracts are preserved. Configuration service schema vocabulary now connected; Hub form consumer remains pending. Final llm scope review read the entire 322-line module: schema vocabulary, explicit open-owner categories, local reference traversal, annotation vs Schema separation, no generated defaults, config/policy envelope projection, Host observation markers and numeric-only inline narrowing. Recursive dynamic property/schema paths and empty structural containers reviewed against current llm consumers. The two None literals are local validation iterator exhaustion sentinels, not stored/policy fallback. Hub Schema form traversal stays explicitly incomplete. Whole input registry and SchemaForm review with canonical Schema, Project fields, restart metadata, input-key and theme Owners. Twenty complete old functions expand identically; the one constructor difference has actual field/callback/copy/Host-lock comparisons. Existing tests and assertions unchanged. SchemaForm consumer is migrated; other known Hub Schema grammar consumers remain pending and are not silently treated as complete. Final 2026-10-25 shared-consumer closure: All actual Hub form/resource/question/setting consumers use SchemaKeyword/Type/Boolean and Owner traversal. Schema vocabulary is shared while domain schemas remain with their own Owners; UI descriptions do not become validation authority. Actual source/reference evidence and bounded test provenance are documented in contract-closure.md; final integrated Gate57 remains required. Agent form contract review: optional selected-Engine describe_agent is pure; the same schema intersects the closed Agent envelope and validates binding before for_agent. Loop reuses its Adapter/parameter schemas, Graph exposes its existing workflow allow-list, and schema nesting preserves owner resource scopes and local references. No configured values, persisted records, approval receipts or execution owners change. Schema composition fix review: standalone local-reference schemas remain resources; existing resource IDs are preserved, anonymous resources receive deterministic schema-only identities, and references/shared nodes are never rewritten. Registry name selection intersects at root without moving or mutating owner properties. Binding and for_agent checks remain unchanged; external references/defaults stay rejected. Generated schema identities are protocol metadata, not user settings, persisted values or network locations. Schema collision review: anonymous owners receive deterministic hierarchical resource identities so relative child IDs remain independent. Explicit IDs are not rewritten. reason: All event declarations and attached-checkpoint, diagnostic, progress and failure-code validation reviewed. Progress phases and optional error-code observations use StepEventMetadata; invalid/missing display hints retain the original fallback and never repair persisted evidence. Slot-derived assignment references the sole field declaration. The exact public class identity is exported through base, with one implementation. Narrow public Facade consumers use the Run-owned resumable candidate states, EngineEvent factory, live RunManager gauges and uncommitted operation preview. All required safety checks and original read/effect order remain. Recovery uses canonical typed analysis/summary requests and response validation, and original Engine/Provider streaming option and reception observations. Actual helper payloads/prompts, cancellation/acknowledgement, budget/admission and effect invariants are preserved; no additional retry or replay path. Transient reasoning state and Step display use typed state and canonical domain/Engine observations. Step reuse declaration is shared by actual Tool/Loop/Graph Writers without changing wire values, receipt reuse or execution authority. Commit-group review 2026-10-31: related records share one explicit completion/permission, never a time window or producer lookahead. Session recovery and Run finalization use the existing record journal; prepared checkpoint attachments share lifecycle ACK. Critical journal fsync, materialization-before-notification, Activity best-effort isolation, separate approval/effect boundaries and explicit resume remain. No policy/default, persisted schema or Hub change. Failure/cancellation/uncertain-fsync coverage: tests.llm.test_commit_groups. Finalization retains Run-end journal retirement via StorageIO.checkpoint; no Session-lifetime journal accumulation. Preparation/selection delta review: execution_boundary is a closed control event with no payload, mutation, metadata or authority grant. It requires the service to synchronize prior preparation; the Engine itself never writes files. Preparation/selection delta review: A Step start may attach only its own pending Completion. The existing record dataclass remains source of truth. Separate public observations are derived after shared durable publication. No authority is accepted from metadata. Tool-feedback/question delta review 2026-11-04: STEP_HANDLED requires failed-Step checkpoint evidence and cannot overwrite the failure. QUESTION_POSTED validates input-only questions with source Step and no approval binding. Service publication owns persistence.

Retained record journal review: commit durability belongs to the checksummed ordered bundle; materialized files are synchronized once at the first undo mutation or last ownership release. A durable checkpoint watermark precedes journal deletion; recovery validates the whole chain and coalesces replacements/appends before writes. Proof is limited to continuous OS ownership. No Engine/Tool replay, policy/default changes or domain format migration. Memory explicitly declares its existing JSON-only observation write; shared lifecycle/storage runner is preserved. Failure/cancellation, missing sequence, superseded journals and backup cases are covered by tests.llm.test_record_transactions; approval/nested resume regressions remain unchanged. Storage/preparation review 2026-10-31: RecordJournal owns the explicit checksummed frame format, sequence and offsets. One retained segment amortizes directory synchronization; every accepted frame still fsyncs before target application/observation. Recovery validates the entire complete chain before target mutation or final-tail trimming. Ordinary undo/final ownership release checkpoints targets and watermark before removing segments. No old-format reader, tuning value or effect replay is introduced. Commit-group review 2026-10-31: related records share one explicit completion/permission, never a time window or producer lookahead. Session recovery and Run finalization use the existing record journal; prepared checkpoint attachments share lifecycle ACK. Critical journal fsync, materialization-before-notification, Activity best-effort isolation, separate approval/effect boundaries and explicit resume remain. No policy/default, persisted schema or Hub change. Failure/cancellation/uncertain-fsync coverage: tests.llm.test_commit_groups. Finalization retains Run-end journal retirement via StorageIO.checkpoint; no Session-lifetime journal accumulation.
Preparation review 2026-10-31: Checkpoint preparation reserves the existing next-sequence journal filename before request timing. Empty files are not records or acknowledgements. Every actual frame still fsyncs; failed reservation resets state for recovery, while final release removes unused empty files. reason: Read the entire transfer Owner and every product, repository extension, callback, fault injection and raw-wire consumer. Intent/source/receipt/inventory and observation schemas have single declarations and typed internal consumers; JSON appears only at authorization, storage, clone and facade boundaries. Source/target receipts, exact history/Run witnesses, original CAS revision, deadline, idempotency, no-replay, transaction/ACK and actual effects assertions are retained. Declaration-only classification is occurrence-specific; neighboring modules are not approved. JSON syntax ownership review: validator calls now target JsonObject. The validator body is AST-identical after expanding its canonical declarations; each consumer AST is identical after normalizing only that call/import, and every original import scope is preserved, including the isolated worker. Record-specific mandatory fields, policy, identity, version, CAS, effects and permission validation are unchanged. ProjectConfig retains a direct public delegate, never a second validator.
